name: anysite-gtm
description: Find and qualify the B2B companies and people to sell to. A short onboarding learns your offer, ideal customer profile and buyer personas from your website; then build target account and contact lists from 70M+ companies and 856M+ professional profiles, add funding and buying signals, map who decides at an account, keep HubSpot or Pipedrive enriched, and draft outreach grounded in real, dated events.
